ModMetaData.name: Ratkin Faction: Acorn Expedition Guild (橡實大遠征商會)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a new Ratkin faction - the Acorn Expedition Guild: earnest, hard-working, hopelessly clumsy ratkin haulers who believe stockpiling enough acorns will cancel winter.
- New FactionDef built on NewRatkinPlus pawn kinds, traders and culture. - Ships a Worldbuilder world preset "Acorn Road" (橡實之路): ratkin kingdom + two guild branches + vanilla factions on a forested world. - Works WITHOUT Worldbuilder as a normal faction mod; with Worldbuilder installed the preset appears in the world preset list.
新增鼠族派系「橡實大遠征商會」：認真努力但常常出包的搬運鼠鼠們。未安裝 Worldbuilder 時作為普通派系 mod 生效；安裝 Worldbuilder 後額外提供世界預設「橡實之路」。
Requires: NewRatkinPlus (and its dependencies HAR + Harmony). Optional: Worldbuilder (for the bundled world preset).
